_template_note: Fill every @@FILL:...@@. 'patch' is the GOLD solution (single source of truth — solve.sh applies THIS). 'test_patch' is the hidden test file(s). base_commit stays 'HEAD' (the Dockerfile re-inits HEAD to your pinned SHA); put the real SHA in _base_commit_sha (validate.sh + the Docker --build-arg read it). fail_to_pass must be RED at base and GREEN with gold; pass_to_pass must already exist AND pass at _base_commit_sha. patch & test_patch MUST be full `git diff` output beginning with 'diff --git'. before_repo_set_cmd runs in the verifier BEFORE it re-applies test_patch, so it must CLEAR the net-new test files (path-scoped `rm -f <test paths>`) so test_patch can add them cleanly. Do NOT use `git clean` (Nest structural rejects it) and do NOT `git checkout HEAD -- <net-new path>` (the file is not in HEAD -> 'pathspec did not match' -> Gold tests checkout failed -> oracle 0; committing it into base instead makes test_patch's new-file apply conflict with 'already exists'). Use `git checkout HEAD -- <path>` ONLY for a test_patch that MODIFIES a pre-existing tracked file.
_base_commit_sha: @@FILL:40-hex commit where the target feature is ABSENT@@
patch: @@FILL:gold solution as FULL `git diff` output. MUST begin with 'diff --git a/<path> b/<path>' (a bare ---/+++/@@ unified diff is REJECTED). Newline-escaped JSON string. solve.sh applies this verbatim, byte-equal.@@
test_patch: @@FILL:hidden tests as FULL `git diff` output. MUST begin with 'diff --git a/<path> b/<path>'. Newline-escaped JSON string.@@
pass_to_pass: @@FILL:existing tests that must stay green at base, e.g. tests/test_verify.py::test_oracle_returns_1@@
selected_test_files_to_run: @@FILL:existing regression test files referenced in pass_to_pass@@
before_repo_set_cmd: rm -f @@FILL:the exact test paths test_patch ADDS, space-separated, e.g. tests/test_<feature>.py@@
